tasks.title: MCP on rmcp (stdio, streamable HTTP, SSE, OAuth); keep mcp.json loader + tool naming

log.text: Design decision: rmcp 3.4.1 (a) parses results into typed structs (ServerResult is an untagged union; tools/call -> CallToolResult), so the tool-result text hoocode sends the model (JSON.stringify of the server's raw result) would be re-serialized from rmcp's structs: unknown fields dropped, keys in rmcp's order; identical for plain {content:[{type:text,text}]} results. (b) rmcp 3.x no longer has a legacy HTTP+SSE client, which hoocode still supports (type:sse and the 4xx fallback), so that transport stays hand-written either way. Options: (1) rmcp for stdio + streamable HTTP + OAuth (auth feature), hand-written legacy SSE, accept the result re-serialization deviation; (2) keep the hand-rolled transport (make it async, raw JSON), add streamable-HTTP session handling + OAuth by hand, no rmcp. Recommendation: (1), plan section 3.4 intent, with the deviation documented.
